{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Remove commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Check number of rows after removal
print("Rows after removing QA orders:", len(df_clean))"}
